ios.desc:
Your photos are personal. Media Den keeps them that way — encrypting everything with AES-256 before it ever reaches your cloud. No ads. No tracking. No backdoors. Just your media, in your hands.

Unlike other photo vault apps, Media Den never routes your files through a shared server. Every file is encrypted on your device before it ever touches the network, then sent directly to your own storage account. Only you hold the key.

- End-to-End Encryption
Every file is encrypted with AES-256-GCM using a key derived from your password via PBKDF2 (600,000 iterations) — both algorithms standardized by NIST (SP 800-38D and SP 800-132). Even if someone accessed your cloud storage directly, they would see only opaque encrypted blobs — unreadable without your password.

- Your Storage, Your Rules
Connect Media Den to your existing Amazon S3 bucket, Google Drive account, or iCloud Drive. You own the data, you choose where it lives, and you can walk away at any time with your files intact. There is no Media Den server in the loop.

- Cloud Replication and Migration
Attach a second cloud as a replica and Media Den mirrors every upload automatically in the background. When you're ready to switch, promote the replica to primary in one tap — no re-uploading, no downtime. Move from S3 to Google Drive, iCloud to S3, or any combination without ever re-encrypting or re-importing your library.

- Nearby Share
Send photos and videos directly to someone nearby over your local network — no cloud upload, no internet required. Media Den uses end-to-end encryption with a Curve25519 key exchange and AES-256-GCM to secure every transfer. Each session generates a fresh set of encryption keys that are never reused or stored, so past transfers stay private even if a device is later compromised. To guard against interception, both devices display a matching 6-digit verification code derived from the session key — if the codes match, the connection is genuine. Shared media never touches an external server.

- Export and Share
Decrypt and save files back to your camera roll at any time, or share them directly with any app via the standard iOS share sheet. You decide what leaves the vault.

- No Tracking or Telemetry
Media Den collects no analytics, telemetry, crash reports, or usage data of any kind. There are no third-party SDKs phoning home, no logging of what you import or view, and no account required. Your usage stays entirely on your device.

quotes.text:
I got tired of not having a good solution for storing pics/vids on my iPhone, that weren't a part of the regular Photos ecosystem.

Existing options are built for the mass-market, but I wanted to be able to control where I stored my data, and I wanted to ensure that I was using client-side encryption.

So I built one, would love some feedback. If you're interested in trying it out (free for my first users if you don't mind giving me some feedback), hit me up.

First round of features are:

  - Configure your own storage backend that _you_ control (S3, GDrive, iCloud)
  - Client-side encryption (AES-256-GCM with PBKDF2)
  - Pin, auto-locking, metadata stripping, blur-when-in-background, delete-on-import
  - Zero telemetry, zero tracking, zero outbound connectivity except to talk to your configured storage system
